text:
# listing.distance

TL;DR:
- listing.distance is the geo distance in kilometers from the query context to the listing.

What it means:
- It depends on query geo context such as meta.latLon.
- Null means distance is not available or not applicable.

Agent hint:
- Mention it when the user asked for nearby results. Ignore it when the search was not geo-aware.
